en.title: Acne & Skin
en.who: Guests who mark breakouts, oily skin, breakouts before their period, marks left after pimples, or breakouts when stressed. Ask Irene for her skin guide sheet too.
studyWhy: all illness starts in the gut

say: I totally get it. You do everything right on the outside, and it still keeps coming back. And it always shows up at the worst time.
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "When do you break out most, and where?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my sister", "a friend from school"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that a pimple needs four things, and skincare only handles two of them. The oil and the inflammation are set from the inside, by sugar spikes, the gut, stress and sleep.
So I'd work on it from the inside and the outside together, starting with this.
found.tip: One or two sentences from Part A, then the routine. Pick the products that match what they marked.

en.ask: From what you told me, I'd start with these, inside and outside together. Want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: Deep painful lumps, scarring, acne with irregular periods or extra hair growth, or breakouts affecting their mood? See a doctor or dermatologist first. Pregnant, trying, or on hormonal birth control? Ask the doctor before Cycle Support. Pregnant or breastfeeding: no ashwagandha.
groups: Calm the gut and the liver
Fade the marks, block the sun
know: A pimple needs four things.

Too much oil, a blocked pore, bacteria and inflammation. Skincare handles the last two; the oil and the inflammation are set from the inside. That's why clearing the surface alone buys a few good weeks, then the same spots come back.
Sugar spikes turn the oil up.

Sweet drinks, white rice and takeout spike blood sugar, insulin raises IGF-1, and IGF-1 tells the oil glands to make more oil and inflames them. In trials, a low-sugar-load diet lowered IGF-1 in two weeks and cut spots by twelve. You don't quit rice, you stop the spike.
Your skin shows what your gut is doing.

When the gut tips out of balance, things that should leave the body get through, and inflammation rises everywhere, skin included. The same imbalance absorbs less zinc and omega-3, the nutrients repair depends on.
Washing harder makes it oilier.
Strip the skin and it thinks it's damaged, so it makes more oil. Dehydrated skin does the same. Wash gentler and keep it hydrated.
Next week's pimple is already clogged today.
Salicylic acid dissolves in oil, so it gets inside the pore and breaks the plug up. Use the toner on the whole face, not just the spot you can see.
Marks are mostly pigment, not scars.

They fade, but they outlast the pimple by months, and picking and sun make them darker. Patch instead of picking, and wear sunscreen every day. Vitamin C keeps marks from getting darker; it doesn't bleach the ones you have.
Where it shows is a clue.

Nose folds, T-zone and chin is the classic B2 pattern, and late nights burn B2 fast. Along the jaw before a period is the monthly hormone shift, and because it comes on schedule, you can get ahead of it.
Stress and short nights turn the oil up.
Oil glands carry receptors for the stress signal, and skin does most of its repair while you sleep. In the 72 assessments we have on file, 77% of acne cases also reported chronic late nights.
routine: Mousse cleanser, anti-acne toner over the whole face, Vitamin C serum, then SPF 50 (or the SPF 30 day lotion)
Plant Protein instead of a sweet breakfast, with Vitamin C
Carb Blocker before the meal, Prebiotic Fiber in water or coffee
Cleanse, toner, Spot On Dots on any new spot, Sleeping Mask, and bed early

zh.title: 皮肤与痘痘
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了爆痘、出油、经期前冒痘、痘印、压力一大就冒痘的客人。也可以找Irene要她的皮肤指南。

say: 我特别懂。外面该用的都用了，还是反反复复。而且总在最不想冒的时候冒出来。
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“一般什么时候最容易冒？长在哪里？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我姐姐”“我一个同学”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来学到，长一颗痘要四件事凑齐，护肤品只管得了其中两件。出油和发炎是身体里面决定的：血糖冲高、肠道、压力、睡眠。
所以我会建议里外一起调，先从这个开始。
found.tip: 从 Part A 挑一两句讲，然后讲作息。挑跟对方勾的对得上的产品。

zh.ask: 按你说的情况，我建议里外一起，先从这几样开始。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 如果是又深又痛的硬包、已经留疤、痘痘同时伴随月经不规律或毛发变多，或者痘痘让你情绪很低落，请先去看医生或皮肤科。怀孕、备孕或在吃激素避孕药的，吃女性周期支持前先问医生。怀孕或哺乳期不吃南非醉茄。
know: 一颗痘，要四件事凑齐。
油太多、毛孔堵住、细菌、发炎。护肤品只管得了后两件，出油和发炎是身体里面决定的。所以只清表面，通常好上几周，同样的地方又冒出来。
血糖冲高，油就被调大。
奶茶、白米饭、外卖让血糖冲高，胰岛素跟着升，又带高IGF-1，它让皮脂腺出更多油，也更容易发炎。试验里，低升糖饮食两周IGF-1就降了，十二周痘就少了。不用戒米饭，只要别让血糖冲那么高。
肠道好不好，皮肤看得出来。
肠道菌群一失衡，本该排出去的东西漏进来，全身的炎症都会升高，皮肤也一样。同样的失衡还会让锌和Omega-3这些修复要用的营养吸收变差。
越洗越油。
洗得太干净，皮肤以为自己受伤了，反而出更多油。缺水的皮肤也一样，越缺水越油。要洗得温和，把水补够。
下周的痘，今天毛孔已经堵上了。
水杨酸溶于油，能钻进毛孔把堵塞化开。所以爽肤水要擦整张脸，不只点在看得见的那一颗上。
痘印大多是色素，不是疤。
它会淡，只是比痘多留好几个月，挤和晒都会让它更深。冒出来就贴，别挤，每天擦防晒。维C是让印子不再变深，不是把已有的漂白。
长在哪里，本身就是线索。
鼻翼、T区、下巴，是典型的缺B2，熬夜会把B2很快耗掉。经期前下巴一圈冒，是每个月的荷尔蒙变化，好在它很准时，可以提前准备。
压力大、睡得少，油就出得多。
皮脂腺上有接收压力信号的受体，皮肤又主要在睡觉时修复。我们手上的72份评估里，77%的痘痘个案同时长期晚睡。
routine: 保湿慕斯洁面，玫瑰控痘爽肤水擦全脸，维C精华，最后SPF50防晒（或SPF30日霜）
把甜的早餐换成有机植物蛋白粉，配维生素C
饭前吃阻碳片，益生元纤维粉加进水或咖啡
洁面、爽肤水，新冒的痘贴上痘痘贴，涂睡眠面膜，早点睡
